warning: Five physical test cases, three optimizer seeds, overlapping LOSO fitting sets. Nominal exact sign-flip p assumes independent sign symmetry of paired case differences; this is unverified. Bootstrap is conditional empirical case sensitivity, not a calibrated population confidence interval. Frames, pairs and seeds are not physical replicates.
primary_family: Original GNN minus competing model classes; five contrasts with Holm.
units: RMSE in percent of initial graph height; deltas in percentage points.
interpretation: Synthetic images and pseudo-labels add zero independent mechanical observations. No primary benchmark replacement or test-based arm selection.
